Subject: Harbor State monthly BDC note

Harbor State has $95.5mm across three BDC positions: FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP ($42.0mm), FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING ($18.0mm), and FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC ($35.5mm).

This month’s filing signals were negative across all three holdings. Golf showed two new markdowns, Hotel showed one markdown, one maturity extension, and a PIK increase, and Juliett showed one markdown, one maturity extension, and a new PIK position. Coverage in this note is limited to the paired-period signals surfaced from the latest schedules for the client’s held BDCs.

FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP

- Net: continued valuation pressure in two portfolio names. This adds to the existing watchlist concern on rising PIK share, but the current release signal set here is markdown-driven.

FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING

- Net: Hotel had the broadest mix of stress indicators this month, with valuation weakness, a maturity extension, and higher PIK in separate names.

FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC
- Crestline Roofing Holdings LLC was marked to 90.0 from 97.5, a 7.5 point decline (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 103; prior row 503).
- Dunmore Insurance Brokers LLC extended from 2028-03-15 to 2030-03-15, a two-year pushout (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 104; prior row 504).
- Foxglove Specialty Pharma Inc. moved to 2.5 PIK from 0.0, up 2.5 points (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 106; prior row 506).
- Net: Juliett also showed a three-part deterioration pattern across separate borrowers: markdown, extension, and new PIK.

Bottom line
- The release set points to incremental credit deterioration across Harbor State’s BDC book rather than an isolated issue in one manager.
- The largest single valuation move was at Juliett, where Crestline Roofing fell 7.5 points.
- Hotel and Juliett each posted new or increased PIK, which we treat as a stress signal only because it increased in the current period.
- Golf had no PIK increase in the surfaced signals this month, but it still posted two 6.5 point markdowns.
